name: patient_is_treated_at_royal_infirmary_edinburgh_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently being treated at Royal Infirmary Edinburgh.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently being treated at Royal Infirmary Edinburgh.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not being treated at Royal Infirmary Edinburgh.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently being treated at Royal Infirmary Edinburgh.

name: patient_serum_amylase_raised_value_recorded_now_withunit_units_per_liter
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current serum amylase level in units per liter.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a numeric measurement of the patient's current serum amylase (in units per liter) is available.

name: reference_range_upper_limit_for_serum_amylase_now_withunit_units_per_liter
meaning: Numeric value representing the current upper limit of the reference range for serum amylase in units per liter for the laboratory.
when_unknown: Set to null if the value is not available, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value if the current upper limit of the reference range for serum amylase (in units per liter) for the laboratory is available.

name: patient_has_elevated_serum_amylase_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has elevated serum amylase (>3x upper limit of reference range for the laboratory).
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current serum amylase is greater than 3 times the upper limit of the reference range for the laboratory.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current serum amylase is not greater than 3 times the upper limit of the reference range for the laboratory.
when_unknown: Set to null if either the serum amylase value or the reference range upper limit is not available or indeterminate.

name: patient_has_undergone_computerized_axial_tomography_now_outcome_is_positive
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has currently undergone a CT scan with a positive result (evidence of disease).
when_true: Set to true if the patient has currently undergone a computerized axial tomography (CT) scan and the result is positive (shows evidence of disease).
when_false: Set to false if the patient has currently undergone a CT scan and the result is negative (shows no evidence of disease).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has currently undergone a CT scan with a positive result.

name: patient_has_undergone_ultrasonography_now_outcome_is_positive
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has currently undergone an ultrasonography with a positive result (evidence of disease).
when_true: Set to true if the patient has currently undergone an ultrasonography (ultrasound scan) and the result is positive (shows evidence of disease).
when_false: Set to false if the patient has currently undergone an ultrasonography and the result is negative (shows no evidence of disease).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has currently undergone an ultrasonography with a positive result.
